decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The basement hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as [    ].
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the northern elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern elevation of the property hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday and 08.30 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) Schedule 2 Part 1 Classes A, B, D and E, no extension, porch, alteration or addition to the roofs and no enclosure, shed, building or pool shall be erected, constructed or placed on the site without the express permission of the LPA.
Condition : 10 - The proposed vehicular entrance safety features should remain operational 24 hrs and be maintained in good working order for as long as the vehicular entrance is in use.
description: Removal of condition 10 (visibility splays) and variation of Condition 3 (in accordance with plans) to allow alternative visibility safety measures to consent 00622/55/P7 dated 9/2/09 for the erection of a new house.
